meta.scalability_note: 6 EU zones (Zurich, Geneva, Frankfurt, Vienna, Munich, Sofia); managed K8s; auto-scaling groups; no serverless FaaS
meta.performance_note: ISO 27001; 99.95% SLA; Swiss and EU data residency; GDPR-by-design; NVMe storage

AWS Amplify.note: No full-stack application hosting or integrated CI/CD platform equivalent to Amplify

AWS Lambda.note: No FaaS or serverless function service available

Amazon ECS.note: No managed container runtime service without Kubernetes; containers require SKE

Amazon EKS.note: Fully managed Kubernetes with node pool auto-scaling and multi-zone support

Amazon EC2.note: Flexible instance types (Standard, CPU, Memory, GPU, Storage) with NVMe SSD storage

AWS Batch.note: No managed batch compute service available

AWS Elastic Beanstalk.note: No PaaS application deployment platform available

Amazon S3.note: S3-compatible object storage with multi-zone redundancy within region and lifecycle policies

Amazon EBS.note: NVMe/SSD block volumes with snapshots and detach/reattach from instances

AWS Backup.note: Instance snapshots and volume snapshots available; no centralised cross-service backup policy engine

Amazon EFS.note: No managed shared or elastic network file system service available

Amazon RDS.note: Managed PostgreSQL, MySQL, and OpenSearch with automated backups and high availability

Amazon DocumentDB.note: No managed MongoDB-compatible document database service available

Amazon DynamoDB.note: No managed serverless NoSQL key-value database available

Amazon Timestream.note: No managed time-series database service available

Amazon Aurora.note: No high-performance MySQL/PostgreSQL-compatible cloud-native database equivalent

Amazon ElastiCache.note: Managed Redis with HA and auto-failover; part of the same DBaaS product

Amazon Redshift.note: No managed cloud data warehouse service available

AWS Application Load Balancer.note: Managed HTTP/HTTPS and TCP load balancing with TLS termination and health checks

AWS Network Load Balancer.equivalent: Exoscale Network Load Balancer (NLB) — TCP/UDP mode
AWS Network Load Balancer.note: TCP/UDP load balancing available in the same NLB product alongside HTTP/HTTPS

Amazon VPC.note: Private L2 networks, security groups, and elastic IPs for full network isolation

Amazon Route 53.note: Managed DNS with full record type support and configurable low TTL

Amazon API Gateway.note: No managed API gateway or gateway-as-a-service available

AWS Direct Connect.note: No dedicated private connectivity product equivalent to Direct Connect

Amazon Rekognition.note: No managed image or video analysis AI service available

Amazon SageMaker.note: No managed ML model training and deployment platform available

Amazon Bedrock.note: No managed foundation model or generative AI API service available

AWS Glue.note: No managed ETL or data integration service available

Amazon EMR.note: No managed big data processing (Spark/Hadoop) service available

Amazon Athena.note: No serverless interactive query service for object storage available

AWS IAM.note: Fine-grained RBAC with users, roles, and API key scoping per service and operation

Amazon Cognito.note: No managed identity and user pool service for application authentication

AWS IAM Identity Center.note: No SSO or centralised identity federation service available

AWS KMS.note: No managed key management service; storage encryption is handled at the infrastructure level

AWS Secrets Manager.note: No managed secrets storage or rotation service available

AWS Certificate Manager.equivalent: Exoscale Load Balancer TLS (Let's Encrypt integration)
AWS Certificate Manager.note: TLS via Let's Encrypt integration with load balancers; no standalone certificate management service

Amazon GuardDuty.note: No managed threat detection or intelligent security monitoring service available

AWS Security Hub.note: No centralised security posture management or findings aggregation service available

AWS Config.note: No managed resource configuration tracking or compliance service available

AWS Shield.note: Data center DDoS protection included; no application-layer mitigation or advanced protection service

AWS WAF.note: No managed web application firewall service available

AWS CloudTrail.note: API request logs for account activity available; limited retention period and export options compared to CloudTrail

Amazon CloudWatch.note: Resource metrics exportable to Datadog/Grafana; no native integrated dashboard at CloudWatch scale or depth

Amazon SNS.note: No managed pub/sub notification or push messaging service available

AWS Systems Manager.note: No managed operational management or configuration compliance service available

AWS Cost Explorer.note: Per-resource usage and cost tracking available directly in the management portal

AWS CodeBuild.note: No managed CI build service available

AWS CodeDeploy.note: No managed deployment automation service available

AWS CodePipeline.note: No managed CI/CD pipeline orchestration service available

Amazon ECR.note: No managed container registry; customers use Docker Hub or self-hosted registries

AWS CloudFormation.note: No native IaC service; official Terraform and Pulumi providers available for infrastructure automation

AWS IoT Core.note: No managed IoT connectivity or device messaging service available

AWS IoT Device Management.note: No managed IoT device fleet management service available

Amazon SQS.note: Managed Kafka cluster available and can be used for queue-like messaging patterns; not a native SQS equivalent

Amazon EventBridge.note: No managed serverless event bus or event routing service available

AWS Step Functions.note: No managed workflow orchestration or state machine service available

Amazon SES.note: No managed transactional or bulk email sending service available

Amazon Kinesis.note: Managed Kafka covers real-time data streaming use cases comparable to Kinesis Data Streams
